summary_en: KH Neochem authorized acquisition of up to 3.7 million shares (10.5% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 12 billion yen through market purchases from November 2026 to October 2027, and decided to cancel 1.993 million shares on December 11, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Matters Related to Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
KH Neochem's Board of Directors resolved on November 5, 2026 to acquire its own ordinary shares and to cancel treasury stock. The company will acquire up to 3.7 million shares, representing 10.5 percent of outstanding shares (calculated from 35,155,916 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum total amount of 12 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period from November 6, 2026 to October 29, 2027.

Simultaneously, the company decided to cancel 1,993,000 shares on December 11, 2026. The company stated that these actions are intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while also enabling flexible capital policy implementation in response to changes in the business environment.
